# Codex Switcher v0.1.101

- Added the Claude Code provider plugin with API-key configuration, environment gateway connections, credential conflict detection, and configuration history rollback.
- Added environment gateway route previews, model identity modes, account pools, diagnostics, and environment-level CLI/App launch entry points.
- Refined account and environment management flows, including environment-aware account creation, image-capable model defaults, and plugin card configuration.
- Added a non-secret `experimental_bearer_token` placeholder to Switcher-managed ChatGPT gateway profiles for Codex config compatibility.
